prompt: By the time the external auditors arrive on Monday, the finance team ___ (complete) the annual accounts.
explanation: La contabilidad estará terminada antes de la llegada futura de los auditores: will have completed.

prompt: According to the revised schedule, the contractors ___ (not / finish) the tunnel by the start of the rainy season.
explanation: By the start fija el límite futuro antes del que la obra no estará acabada.

prompt: ___ (you / submit) the grant application by 5 p.m. tomorrow?
explanation: La pregunta consulta si la entrega estará completada antes de una hora límite.

prompt: By 2035, rising seas ___ (force) several coastal communities to relocate.
explanation: By 2035 presenta el traslado como un resultado ya producido para entonces.

prompt: How many applications ___ (the inspectors / examine) by the time the registration period closes?
explanation: Se pregunta por una cantidad completada antes de que cierre el plazo.

prompt: Even after the weekend shift, the laboratory ___ (not / process) all the samples by Monday morning.
explanation: All the samples exige valorar el resultado completo al llegar el lunes.

prompt: By the end of the expedition, the researchers ___ (map) all three valleys.
explanation: All three valleys expresa una tarea que estará totalmente acabada al final de la expedición.

prompt: The council will have approved the budget by Tuesday.
solution: The council will not have approved the budget by Tuesday.
explanation: La negación se coloca entre will y have: will not have approved.

prompt: The restoration team will have reopened the gallery before the festival begins.
solution: Will the restoration team have reopened the gallery before the festival begins?
explanation: Will pasa delante del sujeto; have y el participio permanecen juntos.

prompt: At 8 p.m., the technicians will have completed the upgrade, so users can log in again.
explanation: A las ocho la actualización ya estará completada; el foco está en el resultado, no en una acción en curso.

prompt: By the time the chair opens the session, every delegate will have received the amended proposal.
explanation: La recepción quedará completada antes de que se abra la sesión; tras by the time se usa presente.

prompt: By 2040, the region will have restored ninety percent of its wetlands.
explanation: El porcentaje cuantifica un resultado que se habrá alcanzado antes del límite de 2040.
